system.description: With this Charm, the raksha can scrape together gossamer from the scraps of raw potential that pool around uncapped demesnes. The raksha must visit an uncapped demesne, which can yield gossamer only once per story. Once the raksha activates this Charm, the demesne provides gossamer equal to its rating. In addition, the raksha automatically gains the following innate power in Creation: Innate Power (Cost: 1m; Speed: 5): The raksha spends a mote of Essence, and her player rolls (Perception + Essence), adding the raksha's Cup in automatic successes. On a success, the raksha can sense any uncapped demesnes within (her successes x 10) miles.
